requirement_text: A detected Ollama must be usable, not just detected: the opencode agent prompt overflows Ollama default num_ctx (~2048) so Ollama truncates it and the model loses its instructions/tools and flails. Ollama OpenAI-compat /v1 ignores per-request num_ctx (verified), so aegis creates a lightweight derived model (aegis-<model>, FROM <model> + PARAMETER num_ctx N via /api/create) and points opencode at it.
target_value: with Ollama, the served model context fits the full agent prompt; the model uses the system prompt + tools instead of a truncated prompt.

requirement_text: aegis verifies the derived Ollama ctx model (OC-029) actually loads + responds within a short deadline; if it hangs (e.g. Gemma 3n on Metal) aegis drops it and uses the base model, remembering not to recreate/re-probe it. A detected Ollama either works or degrades to the base — never hangs.

requirement_text: ollamaFallback must ignore aegis own aegis-<model> derivatives when selecting the Ollama base model: Ollama sorts them first, so aegis was picking its own (possibly broken) derived model as the base and falling back onto it -> hang. Filter aegis- names from the base + surfaced list.
target_value: with a stale aegis- derived model present, ollamaFallback selects a real user model as the base, not its own derivative.

requirement_text: aegis embeds the deploy/models data (catalog.json, origin-policy.json, MODEL_REF) so an installed aegis (Homebrew/.deb) run from any directory can provision/profile/gate — deployFileBytes falls back to the embedded copy and the origin policy loads from embedded bytes. Read-only: no download, serve, or calibration mutation.

Never blocks the TUI.

requirement_text: Inner run-test-fix loop: after each edit turn, run the requirement linked tests and feed failures back until green or the step budget trips.
Deterministic context pruning before LLM summarization: an OpenCode plugin dedupes repeated file reads and masks stale tool observations (keep first-N + recent-N).
Persistent sub-task TODO ledger under each requirement: on-disk, seeded from the requirement, re-injected each turn, survives compaction and resume.
Plan-then-act via OpenCode Plan/Build agents: a read-only Plan pass writes the todo ledger; a Build pass executes it.
Sequential sub-agent delegation for context isolation: push exploration or a focused fix into a child session that returns only a summary, one at a time (bandwidth).
Grounded handoff/continuation on compaction: the summary carries the requirement id, todo state, and touched files so a post-compaction window resumes without drift.
Per-edit checkpoint and rollback (shadow-git): snapshot the workspace per edit so a bad mid-task change is recoverable without losing the run.
Per-task step budget + soft repetition detector that parks/escalates (not hard-abort); extends the session run budget with an inner per-task cap.
Tree-sitter repo map with personalized PageRank ranking: build a def/ref symbol graph and elide the top-N into a fixed token budget. Zero model, zero network.
SCIP precise symbol index via MCP (optional precision layer): expose go-to-def/find-refs/symbol-search from a local, offline, no-ML SCIP index.
Grep-first retrieval doctrine and guardrail: the default retrieval path is grep/glob/LSP/repo-map, never an embeddings engine (air-gap + small model).
Incremental on-change re-indexing: Merkle/mtime hash diffing + tree-sitter edit() re-parse under a file watcher, bounded CPU.
Context assembly and ranking: assemble a bounded bundle (repo-map slice + relevant defs + recent files) ranked to fit the small window; persist in SQLite FTS, never embeddings.
Calibrated reasoning budget per difficulty: reasoning length (think on/off + token budget) is a calibration param, OFF by default for simple requirements.
Test-as-verifier is the only closure gate: the model never self-judges done; the linked test/compiler output decides. Guardrail.
Feed test/compiler output verbatim into the edit loop so the model sees the failure text in-loop (the external-oracle signal).
Self-generated test as the self-check: before marking progress, extend/write a test capturing the requirement, then run it (beats an opinion critic for a weak model).
Optional/gated tiny best-of-N (N<=3) with the test suite as selector, budget-gated: generate <=3 candidate edits, keep the one that passes. Unproven at 4B-active.
Task scratchpad file: durable notes (discoveries, decisions, running state) for a long task, re-injected; append-only, distinct from intent.
Human-curated skill/workflow memory: extend skills/ with distilled how-we-did-X routines; induction stays manual (no auto-learn).
Project-memory assembly and precedence: assemble CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/skills into the prompt within the 32k budget, with clear precedence.
Guardrail: no auto-learned memory that rewrites human-authored intent files (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md).
Resolve and run the requirement's linked test(s) after each edit turn; capture pass/fail plus stdout/stderr.
On failure, inject the captured test/compiler output verbatim (bounded) as the next turn's prompt.
Iterate edit->test until green or the inner step/token budget trips, then park/escalate.
Close the loop only on a green test, never on a model 'done' assertion (enforces THINK-002).
Keep the inner test run from overlapping generation (reuse the LOOP-004 phasing).
Tree-sitter parse per file and extract def/ref tags via .scm queries per supported language; cache by mtime.
Build the def->ref symbol graph across files.
Rank symbols/files with personalized PageRank, boosting task-named identifiers and in-context files.
Render the top-N elided skeleton into a fixed token budget and inject it into context.
Expose the repo map to the harness as a context builder or MCP tool, without forking OpenCode.
E2E golden-set harness: drive the full loop over eval/golden end-to-end in a captured sandbox and emit the metric dashboard (ACR/TCVR/FPVR/MTC/WCR/TCR).
Performance suite: per-target tok/s, prefill/decode split, WCR/TCR, latency percentiles, with rolling baselines and a regression gate (hyperfine + bench.sh + metrics).
Accuracy suite: ACR/pass@1 on eval/golden plus an offline SWE-bench-Verified subset, test-as-oracle.
Precision suite: tool-call validity (TCVR), patch-applies-cleanly, no-regression on unrelated tests, and a false-positive-close check.
Egress-zero gate: run the whole suite inside a network-denied sandbox and assert zero non-loopback packets via pcap; extends GUARD-001 suite-wide.
Supply-chain and secret gate: offline secret scan + Go-vuln + SBOM + SAST on the repo and agent-generated code (gitleaks, govulncheck, grype+syft, semgrep).
Sandboxed agent execution: agent-generated code/tests run in a locked sandbox (no network, restricted FS, seccomp/landlock caps) so a run cannot escape or egress (bubblewrap/nsjail).
E2E CI wiring: the suite runs as staged CI gates (build -> unit -> egress-zero -> golden metrics -> security); any red gate fails the build; extends .ci/pipeline.yml.

Semantic stuck/loop detector (OpenHands StuckDetector): a pure-Go check that flags repetition, ping-pong, agent monologue, and repeated-condensation even when nothing errors; hash the last N action/observation pairs (ignore ids) and park on the pattern.
Model/temperature fallback before park: after M identical tool failures, retry once at higher temperature or on the lead quant, then park (RA.Aid FallbackHandler; OpenHands temp 0->1.0).
Research pre-stage: a bounded grep/LSP discovery pass that emits curated facts/snippets to the working-memory store before planning, so the plan starts from curated context (RA.Aid stage 1).
Grammar-constrained structured output (llama.cpp GBNF): enforce a JSON/grammar schema on aegis run output so a weak local model returns deterministically parseable results.

Optional/gated two-quant lead/worker split: a bigger-quant reasoner plans, a fast small-quant editor emits diffs, revert-to-lead after K failures. Unproven for a local architect+editor; validate with a bake-off.

Structured, auto-pruned working-memory store (RA.Aid SQLite KeyFact/KeySnippet + GC): a queryable, size-bounded, machine-written scratch store (emit_fact/emit_snippet via MCP) with count caps to protect the 32k window; kept separate from human intent.

Lazy/tiered context loading (Cline load_mcp_documentation; rules-vs-workflows split): keep verbose tool/procedure docs out of the base prompt and load them only when invoked; lean AGENTS.md + slash-invoked workflow files.

Diff/edit-format bake-off per local model: sweep edit encodings (whole/diff/udiff/per-family) against gemma-4-26B-A4B and record the winner in calibration.json (Cline diffEditSuccess telemetry proves it varies by model).

Native tool-call verification: confirm the model emits native tool-calls (not a shim/code path) before trusting TCVR/MTC, else the bake-off measures a different execution path than the published numbers.

Auto-inject the repo map into the interactive context at launch (context-builder mode): aegis stages a bounded repo map and RenderConfig injects it, so the model always has the codebase skeleton without invoking /map. /map remains for on-demand focused refresh.
